description: This file defines a React component for a Meal Planner page, including subcomponents and hooks for managing state, fetching data from an API, and rendering a calendar interface for meal planning.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the meal plan data for the current week starting date and updates the state.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: React component for adding a new meal entry for a specific date, managing form state and invoking API to save the entry.

methods.name: Planner
methods.description: Main exported React component that composes the meal planner page with navigation and protected route.
